items.description: Close wall opening and repaint affected area
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.2 and 7.1.7(a) cover making good the access opening and restoring the water-damaged finish. €290 gross allows for a small patch and local repainting, not the full room.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge on this contractor's invoice. The gross reference allowance is €81.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers minor consumables used to seal the repaired pipe. €12 gross is a reasonable allowance for one small lot.
Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) cover the replacement section of the failed indoor supply pipe. €30 gross allows for one metre at an equivalent pre-loss specification under 7.1.9.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers like-for-like reinstatement of the insulation on the repaired section. Case 18 supports about €18 gross for this one-metre line.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary installer labour at customary rates. The supplied prior gives €63 gross for one hour.
Section 7.1.7(e) covers necessary investigation, but 7.1.8(b) excludes a separate charge for the contractor's own measuring device. €20 gross is conditional on proof of a necessary external hire.
Sections 7.1.7(a), (e) and (g) cover necessary access, investigation and repair labour. The supplied nine-hour gross prior is €425.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows only the first travel charge per contractor per invoice, even when multiple visits were necessary. €81 is the gross benchmark if separately eligible.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover one dryer deployment for necessary drying before reinstatement. €65 gross reflects brief use on the localized wall damage.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes contractor blades as business equipment. €14 gross is the conditional price benchmark for one blade.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers fittings needed to reconnect the replacement pipe. Two standard fittings at about €19 each give €38 gross.
This repeats line 4, and no separate installed metre is documented. Sections 7.1.8(c)–(d) exclude the apparent duplicate; €30 gross applies if a distinct necessary metre is substantiated.
This appears to repeat the insulation already charged in line 5 for the same localized repair. Under 7.1.8(c)–(d), €18 gross would apply only if a distinct necessary section is documented.
Section 7.1.8(c) bars duplicate billing, and the second nine-hour entry is not tied to distinct work. If shown to be separate and necessary under 7.1.7(g), the supplied gross prior is €425.
